actions.consequence: Moves it to Acknowledged. The issue stays open and keeps counting toward the health pill until Mongoose stops reporting it; nothing on the server changes.

actions.disabledReason: No admin command on Mongoose 1.1.0 (proposal A4). The application can call shutdown() again once the blocker can progress: it resumes without repeating callbacks, and failed closes are not retried.

issues.what: The last shutdown returned incomplete. The server stays STOPPING with unconfirmed cleanup or held names. A listed group or service is not necessarily still executing.

notAvailable.detail: Recovery depends on the dispatch strategy capabilities. Inspect the ERROR/WARNING log; this panel has no structured per-handler history.
Sequence numbers of ProcessorQuarantined, Dead and QueueDrop records are only in a control-audit export.
Only the drop count and health verdict are live; the first QueueDrop record is in the control-audit export.
A failed physical close is reported by resource id; the capture it belongs to is not.
The configured limit cannot be read.
Stop replies expose FailureKind; generic command text does not carry EvidenceStatus. No VERIFIED status is inferred.
Overload states are shown. Use the Commands panel for overload.status and overload.clear <feed>; guided clear/kill-switch controls are not implemented.
